title: Semiconductor Electronics: Materials, Devices and Simple Circuits

topics.title: Classification of metals, insulators and semiconductors

concepts.learning_objective: Classify solids as metals, semiconductors or insulators from their resistivity and conductivity.
Use the energy band gap between valence and conduction bands to explain conduction in metals, insulators and semiconductors.
Explain the thermal generation of electron-hole pairs in pure Si and Ge and the relation ne = nh = ni.
Describe the apparent motion of holes and the total current as the sum of electron and hole currents.
Identify donor and acceptor dopants and the majority and minority carriers in n-type and p-type semiconductors.
Apply ne nh = ni^2 to find carrier concentrations in a doped semiconductor.
Locate donor and acceptor energy levels in the energy band diagram of doped semiconductors.
Explain the roles of diffusion and drift in forming a p-n junction and reaching equilibrium.
Describe the depletion region, its immobile charges, its electric field and the barrier potential.

topics.title: Semiconductor diode under bias and its V-I characteristics

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how forward bias lowers the barrier and causes minority carrier injection and a large current.
Explain how reverse bias raises the barrier, widens the depletion region and gives a small saturation current.
Interpret the V-I characteristic of a diode, including cut-in voltage and dynamic resistance.
Explain the working and output of a half-wave rectifier.
Explain how a centre-tap full-wave rectifier uses two diodes to rectify both half cycles.
Explain how a capacitor input filter smooths the pulsating output of a rectifier.
